project_metadata.tone: Trusted, expansive, highly functional, clean, premium
project_metadata.notes: Anti-default e-commerce. Less cluttered than Amazon, more intentional and clear. High contrast for readability. Admin panel optimized for data density.

headings.weight_strategy: Radical weight contrast (Black vs Light). Tracking tight.

body.weight_strategy: Regular for reading, Medium for labels.
body.usage: Paragraphs, admin tables, product descriptions, forms.

storefront.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (border-border), no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow.
storefront.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (Light) or bg-black/60 (Dark), 1px delicate inner stroke on bottom.
storefront.overlays: Hero images get max bg-black/40 overlay. Gradient overlays preferred over flat blankets.

admin_dashboard.style: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Dense data layouts.
admin_dashboard.cards: Flat solid, max 4px border-radius, pure structural grayscale.
admin_dashboard.tables: border-collapse style layout. Subtle right and bottom borders on grid cells.

storefront.strategy: Generous Spacing (p-8, p-12, p-16). Bento grid for categories. Horizontal scroll for featured products.
storefront.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Large product imagery overlapping containers.

admin_dashboard.strategy: Control Room Grid. Tight gaps (gap-4, gap-6). Dense spacing (p-4, p-6).
admin_dashboard.grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Summary metrics col-span-1, Main charts col-span-2 or 3.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI for logic/forms heavily customized. Custom raw HTML+Tailwind for storefront bento layouts.
components.buttons: Square or slight rounded (max 4px). Brand color only for primary CTAs (Add to Cart, Checkout, Save).
components.inputs: Flat, 1px border. Focus state must have higher contrast (ring-2 ring-brand).
components.charts: Recharts / Shadcn charts. High clarity. Accessible colors.

motion.scroll: Use Lenis for momentum scrolling on storefront.
motion.hover: Explicit hover states (hover:text-white). Color shift to lighter hue.
motion.transitions: Specific property transitions (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).

icons_and_assets.imagery_rules: No pure empty backgrounds. Focus on product in context. Image height max 80vh on mobile.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).

lifestyle.description: Modern decorative ladder with hanging blanket

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn components heavily for the Admin Dashboard (Tables, Cards, Charts).
For the Storefront Homepage, build custom bento layouts using raw HTML+Tailwind for a premium feel (avoiding standard Bootstrap column looks).
Integrate Supabase Auth and Supabase Storage as requested.
Implement light and dark mode toggles.
All navigation elements must be visible on desktop, no hamburger menus on large screens.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').
Keep spacing dense on the Admin Panel but generous on the Storefront.
Avoid Inter for headings. Use Outfit (Headings) and IBM Plex Sans (Body).
Ensure contrast ratios meet accessibility standards, especially when text is over imagery.
